nominee.title: Nominee for your data rights
nominee.intro: If you die or can no longer act for yourself, a person you nominate can exercise your data rights for you (access, correction, erasure). Their details are stored encrypted, and we only act after checking documents.
nominee.name: Nominee's full name
nominee.stepUp: To protect your account, confirm it's you: enter your password, or your authenticator code if you use one.
nominee.limit: You can have up to {max} nominees.
nominee.navBody: Choose who can exercise your data rights if you die or cannot act for yourself.
nominee.reqIntro: Use this form if someone nominated you and they have died or can no longer act for themselves. We check every request against their nomination and your documents before we act.
nominee.yourContact: Your email or mobile number (as given in the nomination)
nominee.groundIncapacity: The account holder cannot act for themselves
nominee.receivedBody: Reference {id}. If you were nominated, our Grievance Officer will contact you for supporting documents (such as a death certificate or guardianship order) and reply within {days} days. For privacy, we do not confirm whether an account or a nomination exists.
nominee.metaDescription: Ask to exercise a deceased or incapacitated person's data rights as their nominee.
